newsitem.title: UK: Mobil brings Nigerian Oso back on stream.
newsitem.headline: Mobil brings Nigerian Oso back on stream.

text.p: Mobil Corp said on Monday its Nigerian Oso condensate field had resumed production after an unscheduled shutdown since the beginning of August.
Production on Monday was running at 11,000 bpd with the full stream expected restored within a few days, a spokesman said.
The company had issued letters of force majeure to lifters of the condensate, informing them of delays in loading because of a longer than expected shutdown.

Nigeria's production of condensate, an extra-light hydrocarbon which is not counted as part of the country's 1.865 million bpd OPEC quota, is expected to reach 200,000 bpd when stage two of the Mobil project comes on stream early next year.
